name: MATH 2144Q
title: Advanced Calculus IV
description: The continuation of the rigorous treatment of advanced topics in multivariable calculus, vector spaces and systems of differential equations.  May be used in place of MATH 2210Q or 2410Q to fulfill any requirement satisfied by MATH 2210Q or 2410Q.
requirement_description: MATH 2143Q. May not be taken for credit after passing MATH 2110Q, MATH 2130Q, MATH 2210Q, MATH 2410Q, or MATH 2420Q.
